If you want the players to know about changes made in this PR, please specify them using the format below.

The changelog validator check is there as a guide– you may ignore it if you have conveyed everything your own way.

:cl: Contributor (Your GitHub or ingame username. Separate multiple contributors by commas!)- Category (Optional– use this if needed to break up different categories in your PR.)
- Addition: An addition is a change to the game that directly adds a feature or mechanic, like adding a crew plushie.
- Removal: A removal is a change to the game that directly takes away from the game, like deleting a broken prototype.
- Tweak: A tweak is anything that doesn't add or take away directly, like changing a stat or refactoring some code.
- Bugfix: A bugfix is any change that corrects functionality that wasn't working how it should, like fixing a broken item.
- Port: A port is a change that has been copied over from a different repository, like from Starlight or from Wizden.

For mapping changes, you can use the same format. Please use the name of the map you're modifying as the category.
-->
